# Nakatomi CRM (Cloudflare edition)

> Headless, agent-native CRM running on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 + KV +
> Queues. REST API at `/v1/*` and an MCP server at `/mcp`. Multi-tenant
> (workspaces), soft-delete, append-only timeline, HMAC-signed webhooks,
> OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, and a pluggable memory-connector layer.

Primary audience: LLM agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Cursor) and the
humans operating them.

## What an agent can do

- Search / create / update / soft-delete contacts, companies, deals,
  products, activities, notes, tasks, files
- Move deals through pipeline stages; build deal totals from line items
  that snapshot product names + prices (history doesn't drift)
- Attach notes, tasks, activities, and files to any entity
- Build and query a typed relationship graph between any two entities
- Read the append-only timeline (`/v1/timeline`) and audit log for any
  entity or the whole workspace
- Subscribe to webhooks for any event type (contact.created,
  deal.moved, …); deliveries go through Cloudflare Queues with DLQ
- Send email via Resend (`POST /v1/email/send`)
- Subscribe to iCal feeds (Google, Microsoft, Fastmail, iCloud) and
  sync them into meeting activities (`POST /v1/calendar/feeds/{id}/sync`)
- Ingest records from CSV or JSON (`POST /v1/ingest`)
- Recall across plugged-in memory systems (DocDeploy, Supermemory,
  GBrain) and cross-link memories to CRM entities

## Auth

Workspace API keys are the recommended path:

```
Authorization: Bearer nk_<prefix>_<secret>
```

The workspace is inferred from the key. Alternatively, a user JWT from
`POST /auth/login` plus `X-Nakatomi-Workspace: <slug-or-id>`. MCP clients
typically obtain access tokens via OAuth 2.1 + PKCE (see
`/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`).

## MCP

- Endpoint: `https://<your-host>/mcp` (streamable HTTP)
- Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer nk_<key>`
- Tools: search/get/create/update_contact, search/create_company,
  list_pipelines, create_deal, move_deal_stage, log_activity, add_note,
  create_task, list_tasks, relate, timeline, memory_list_connectors,
  memory_recall, memory_link, memory_trace, send_email,
  sync_calendar_feed, dashboard_summary

## Discovery

- This file: `/llms.txt`
- A2A agent card: `/.well-known/agent.json`
- OAuth 2.1: `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` and
  `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`

## Platform

| Capability | Cloudflare primitive |
| --- | --- |
| Compute | Workers |
| SQL | D1 |
| Files | R2 |
| Sessions / rate-limit / idempotency | KV |
| Durable webhook delivery | Queues + DLQ |
| Scheduled work | Cron Triggers |
| Static assets | Assets binding |
